title: Tally and WooCommerce Integration
seoTitle: Tally WooCommerce Integration: Orders to Tally Automatically
seoDescription: Sync WooCommerce orders, customers, stock and GST into TallyPrime vouchers. Methods, what syncs, stock updates back to the store, effort and cost ranges.
summary: A Tally–WooCommerce integration turns each WooCommerce order into a TallyPrime sales voucher with the right GST ledgers and stock items, and can push stock levels from Tally back to the store. It suits Indian businesses running their online store on WordPress.

dataPoints.label: WooCommerce side
dataPoints.value: WooCommerce REST API (orders, products, customers) and order webhooks

dataPoints.label: Tally side
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime XML interface via a connector on the Tally machine

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Orders to sales vouchers, customers to ledgers, refunds to credit notes, stock back to products

dataPoints.label: Watch-outs
dataPoints.value: Plugins that change order totals (discounts, shipping, COD fees) must map to ledgers

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: 2–5 weeks custom, depending on plugins and GST complexity

body:
## How it works

1. WooCommerce sends an order webhook when an order is placed or its status changes.
2. The integration maps line items, tax, shipping and discounts to Tally ledgers and stock items.
3. The voucher posts to Tally; failures queue for retry.
4. Optionally, stock levels are read from Tally on a schedule and updated in WooCommerce.

## Plugin-heavy stores

WooCommerce stores often use plugins for GST invoices, COD fees and bundles. Each changes the order data, so the mapping must be tested on real orders before launch.

See [Tally integration](/blog/tally-integration-connecting-your-accounts-to-your-operations-software).

faqs.q: Which order status should create the Tally voucher?
faqs.a: Most businesses post on "processing" or "completed", depending on when they treat the sale as confirmed; cancellations then reverse it.
Yes, typically as sales with a separate receivable until the courier remits the cash.
